DEBT Debt consists of the following (in millions, except percentages): Effective Interest Rate As of October 3, 2025 September 27, 2024 1.80% Senior Notes due 2026 1.97 % $ 500.0 $ 500.0 3.00% Senior Notes due 2031 3.13 % 500.0 500.0 Unamortized debt discount and issuance costs ( 4.2 ) ( 5.7 ) Total debt 995.8 994.3 Less: current portion of long-term debt ( 499.4 ) — Total long-term debt $ 496.4 $ 994.3 Senior Notes On May 26, 2021, the Company issued $ 500.0 million of its 0.90 % Senior Notes due 2023 (the “2023 Notes”), $ 500.0 million of its 1.80 % Senior Notes due 2026 (the “2026 Notes”), and $ 500.0 million of its 3.00 % Senior Notes due 2031 (the “2031 Notes” and, together with the 2026 Notes, the “Notes”). During fiscal 2023, the Company repaid $ 500.0 million of the 2023 Notes at maturity. The Notes are senior unsecured obligations of the Company and rank equally in right of payment with all of its existing and future senior unsecured debt but effectively junior to any of the Company’s senior secured debt to the extent of the value of collateral securing such debt and are structurally subordinated to all existing and future obligations of the Company’s subsidiaries. The Notes will mature on each respective maturity date, unless earlier redeemed in accordance with their terms. Interest on the Notes is payable on June 1 and December 1 of each year. The Company may redeem all or a portion of the 2026 Notes and the 2031 Notes at any time and from time to time prior to maturity, in whole or in part, for cash at the applicable redemption prices set forth in the respective supplemental indenture. If the Company undergoes a change of control repurchase event, as defined in the indenture governing the Notes (as supplemented, the “Indenture”), holders may require the Company to repurchase the Notes in whole or in part for cash at a price equal to 101 % of the principal amount of the Notes to be purchased, plus any accrued and unpaid interest. As of October 3, 2025, the Company considered the likelihood of acceleration related to the 2026 Notes and the 2031 Notes and recorded the Notes as short-term debt and long-term debt, respectively. The Notes are recorded net of discount and issuance costs, which are amortized to interest expense over the respective terms of these borrowings.

passages.text: OF OPERATIONS. The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes that appear elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to historical information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties. Actual results may differ substantially and adversely from those referred to herein due to a number of factors, including, but not limited to, those described below and in Item 1A “Risk Factors” and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. OVERVIEW We, together with our consolidated subsidiaries, are a leading developer, manufacturer and provider of analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products and solutions for numerous applications, including aerospace, automotive, broadband, cellular infrastructure, connected home, defense, entertainment and gaming, industrial, medical, smartphone, tablet, and wearables. Pending Combination With Qorvo On October 27, 2025, we entered into the Merger Agreement with Qorvo, a provider of connectivity and power solutions, to combine Qorvo and Skyworks in a cash-and-stock transaction that values the combined company at approximately $ 22.0 billion as of the market close on October 27, 2025. Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Mergers, each share of Qorvo common stock issued and outstanding immediately prior thereto (with certain exceptions set forth in the Merger Agreement) will be converted into the right to receive 0.960 (the “Exchange Ratio”) of a share of Skyworks common stock and $ 32.50 in cash, without interest, subject to applicable withholding taxes. The Exchange Ratio is expected to result in Qorvo equityholders and Skyworks equityholders owning approximately 37% and 63%, respectively, of the combined company on a pro forma basis following the closing. The Merger Agreement also provides for Skyworks’ assumption of certain Qorvo equity awards, subject to certain adjustments thereto in respect of, among other things, performance-based vesting conditions. Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, immediately following the closing, the Board of Directors will be comprised of 11 directors, consisting of (i) the Chief Executive Officer of Skyworks, who will be the Chief Executive Officer of Skyworks following the closing, (ii) seven directors designated by Skyworks and (iii) three directors designated by Qorvo who are reasonably acceptable to Skyworks, each of whom will hold office until the next annual meeting of stockholders of Skyworks. Promptly following the closing, the Board of Directors will also designate a Chairman. Robert Bruggeworth, Qorvo’s current President, Chief Executive Officer and director, will be one of Qorvo’s designees upon the closing. credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage sits below the sector median, and the balance sheet is in a net cash position once cash and short-term investments are netted against total debt, so the indicative financial risk profile is Minimal. This headroom gives the issuer room to absorb a cyclical downturn in analog semiconductor demand without recourse to new borrowing.

Interest coverage is well above the sector median and operating cash flow to debt also exceeds the peer median, reflecting a debt stack of only two unsecured note tranches. Cash generation comfortably covers the modest fixed interest burden, so debt service is not a constraint on the business.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows the senior notes due in the near term are now classified as current, so a substantial principal repayment falls due within the next twelve months. Refinancing or repayment will draw on cash that is otherwise available for distributions and the pending combination, concentrating liquidity risk in a single year.

Operating margin has fallen year over year and trails the sector median, with revenue and operating income declining across the trend series. Weaker profitability at this point in the cycle reduces the cushion available to fund the cash portion of the announced combination and any integration costs.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow covers dividends and buybacks combined only partially, with distributions exceeding free cash flow, while operating cash flow alone still exceeds total distributions. Shareholder returns therefore absorb most internally generated cash, leaving little retained buffer beyond the existing cash balance.

Free cash flow to debt is above the sector median and the current ratio exceeds the peer median, indicating ample near-term liquidity against the current portion of the notes. Coverage of the maturing tranche from cash and annual free cash flow looks achievable without new issuance.

overall_credit_view.text: The MD&A discloses a pending cash-and-stock combination with a peer, which would materially enlarge the business and add acquisition financing needs. We view execution and integration risk as the principal forward-looking uncertainty, and the combined entity's leverage and liquidity profile cannot be assessed until deal terms and financing are finalized.

On the disclosed figures the issuer carries low leverage, net cash and strong coverage relative to the sector, supporting a favourable credit view. The main offsets are declining operating margin, distributions that outpace free cash flow, and the near-term note maturity, which we judge manageable but worth monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿低於行業中位數，且將現金及短期投資與總債務對沖後，資產負債表處於淨現金狀況，因此指示性財務風險狀況為極低。此緩衝空間讓發行人得以吸收模擬半導體需求週期性下滑，而無需新增借貸。
利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，經營現金流對債務比率亦高於同業中位數，反映債務結構僅由兩批無抵押票據組成。現金產生能力足以輕鬆覆蓋有限的固定利息負擔，因此償債並不構成業務限制。

key_risks.text: 債務票據顯示，短期內到期的優先票據現已分類為流動負債，因此相當規模的本金還款將於未來十二個月內到期。再融資或還款將動用原本可用於分派及待完成合併的現金，令流動性風險集中於單一年度。
經營利潤率按年下降，且低於行業中位數，收入及經營溢利在趨勢序列中均呈下跌。在此週期階段的盈利能力轉弱，減少了可用於支付已公布合併之現金部分及任何整合成本的緩衝。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流不足以全數覆蓋股息及回購合計，分派超過自由現金流，而單計經營現金流仍超過總分派。因此股東回報吸收了大部分內部產生現金，除現有現金結餘外，留存緩衝有限。
自由現金流對債務比率高於行業中位數，流動比率亦高於同業中位數，顯示相對於票據流動部分有充裕的短期流動性。以現金及年度自由現金流覆蓋到期批次看來可以達成，而無需新發行。

overall_credit_view.text: 管理層討論及分析披露與同業的待完成現金加股票合併，將大幅擴大業務並增加收購融資需求。我們認為執行及整合風險為主要前瞻性不確定因素，而在交易條款及融資最終確定前，無法評估合併後實體的槓桿及流動性狀況。
根據披露數字，發行人相對於行業持有低槓桿、淨現金及強勁覆蓋率，支持有利的信用觀點。主要抵銷因素為經營利潤率下降、分派超過自由現金流，以及短期票據到期，我們判斷為可控但值得監察。
